sloka: नैतस्य सहिता लोका भयम् कुर्युर्महामृधे ।अधर्मम् त्विह धर्मात्मा लोकम् धर्मेण योजयेत् ॥२-६१-२०॥
transliteration: naitasya sahitā lokā bhayam kuryurmahāmṛdhe ।adharmam tviha dharmātmā lokam dharmeṇa yojayet ॥2-61-20॥

translations.english: Out of respect for his father magnanimous Rama is not inclined to kill you. He has not defied the anger, the Sun, the Moon and the sky looking wonderful with stars can be pulled down. He will not even shake or break the earth surrounded by hundreds of mountains.
translations.hindi: हे सुमंत्र ! निश्चय ही यह दारुण कष्ट होनी के वशु, इच्वाकु कुल का सर्वनाश करने को अपने आप अथवा देबइच्छा से उपस्थित हुआ है
